runtimeAssetPolicy: Runtime hero objects, landscape silhouettes, vegetation, architecture, villagers, animals, vehicles, and interiors use project-owned Playbot-generated GLB meshes. Terrain, route ribbons, shaders, particles, lighting, and interaction animation control are authored in project source. Reference-board material is not shipped.

procedural.description: Reachable steep mountain-valley terrain generated as a deterministic high-density mesh with slope-based rock and moss shading around two 2.1–2.2 km switchback routes.
Two terrain-conforming Catmull-Rom country-road meshes with shader-generated asphalt aggregate, patching, cracks, edge wear, and no lane stripes.
Terrain-conforming stream ribbons with animated ripples, glints, bank fade, and fog integration.
Speed-reactive camera-local cherry blossom particle field using the generated petal sprite.

One no-board skater rig with a valid walk clip, deterministic grounded ride/push/slide posing because the generator did not export named skating clips, and a separate ridden/carried board; rigged villagers use animation mixers.
Original responsive menu, HUD, journal, comfort controls, and progress workbench.

generatedModels.usage: Current single no-board skinned hero mesh selected by live screenshot A/B; one visible SkinnedMesh with no external rig geometry. Export contains base, walk, and run clips; skating poses are authored at runtime.
Previous clean no-board rig retained as a fallback; replaced at runtime after the v4 screenshot A/B produced a stronger skating silhouette.
Single-mesh mid/far cedar canopy clusters used to increase forest mass efficiently.
Single-mesh mixed cedar and blossom canopy clusters used sparingly on Sakura Ridge.
Detailed utility infrastructure placed along village streets.
Repeatable mossy roadside drainage segments along village roads.
Detailed roadside produce stall on the western village loop.
Compact shrine garden anchoring the eastern village loop.

referenceOnly.usage: External comparison links only; no referenced asset is copied into runtime.
